<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<addon id="plugin.video.xtreammate"
       name="XCMate"
       version="0.1.29.70"
       provider-name="GS Media">

  <requires>
    <import addon="xbmc.python" version="3.0.0"/>
    <import addon="script.module.pil" version="5.1.0"/>
    <import addon="script.module.requests" version="2.27.0" optional="true"/>

</requires>

  <extension point="xbmc.python.pluginsource" library="default.py">
    <provides>video audio</provides>
  </extension>

  <extension point="xbmc.service" library="service.py" start="startup"/>

  <extension point="xbmc.addon.metadata">
    <summary lang="en_GB">XCMate – TV setup wizard for Xtream, M3U and Stalker</summary>
    <summary lang="de_DE">XCMate – IPTV-Einrichtungsassistent mit Xtream, M3U und Stalker</summary>
    <description lang="en_GB">
      Independent GPL-licensed derivative of mr-evil1 TiViMate Kodi, featuring a guided IPTV import process and on-video remote-control live channel and category navigation.
      Features: Multiple M3U playlists, Xtream Codes API (Live/VOD/Series),
      XMLTV EPG, channel groups, favourites, search, catch-up, recordings,
      reminders, sleep timer.
    </description>
    <description lang="de_DE">
      Eigenständiger GPL-Fork von mr-evil1 TiViMate Kodi mit geführter IPTV-Einrichtung und Fernbedienungssteuerung über laufendem Live-TV.
      Funktionen: Mehrere M3U-Playlists, Xtream-Codes-API (Live/VOD/Serien),
      XMLTV-EPG, Sendergruppen, Favoriten, Suche, Catch-up, Aufnahmen,
      Erinnerungen, Sleep-Timer.
    </description>
    <platform>all</platform>
    <license>GPL-2.0-only</license>
    <defaultlanguage>resource.language.en_gb</defaultlanguage>
    <forum>https://forum.kodi.tv</forum>
    <website>https://kodi.tv</website>
    <source>https://github.com/artattakk-creator/kodi-noodleprivate</source>
    <news>German and English language support; Language filter; Xtream auto-detection; Parallel search</news>
    <assets>
      <icon>icon-81da1003a2753ec6.png</icon>
      <fanart>resources/media/lightweight_splash.jpg</fanart>
    </assets>
  </extension>

</addon>

0.1.29.70 (Test-Build)
- EPG-Bildstatus bleibt für seine tatsächliche Gültigkeitsdauer abrufbar; keine falsche Fünf-Minuten-Lücke.
- Angeforderte Bilder von noch nicht bestätigten Hintergrundaufträgen unterscheiden.
- Ein expliziter Wiederholungsauftrag überwindet negative Sitzungscaches kontrolliert.
- Helper-Fehler, eigene TMDB-Suche und Speicherstatus verständlich getrennt anzeigen.
- Portale, Passwörter, TMDB-Zugang, EPG, Cover und Serienfortschritte bleiben erhalten.
- Private Android-Logs noch nicht lesbar; Geräteabnahme NOT_TESTED.

0.1.29.69 (Test-Build)
- EPG-Bilder: geprüfte öffentliche HTTPS-Referenzen direkt anzeigen; lokales Bildarchiv optional.
- Speicherfehler unterscheiden; begrenzte Wiederholungen und Sitzungspuffer statt endloser Bildsuche.
- BINGIE: lokale Texte/Logos und Provider-Cover früher bereitstellen; fehlende Bilder neutral behandeln.
- Live-TV: begrenzte Home-Rückkehr nach bestätigtem Stop; eigene EPG-Detailfenster gezielt freigeben.
- Bestehende Portale, Passwörter/TMDB-Zugang, EPG-Zuordnungen, Cover und Fortschritte bleiben erhalten.
- Android-Geräteabnahme noch NOT_TESTED; kein produktives Release.

0.1.29.68
- Sichtbare EPG-Sendungen und Details erhalten priorisierte Bildaufträge im Service.
- Bildsuche: nachvollziehbare Auftragszustände und quellensicherer Negativcache.
- EPG-/TMDB-Bildeinstellungen und getrennte Speicherdiagnose zentral erreichbar.
- Mini-EPG mit lokalem Warmstart und unterscheidbaren Ladezuständen.
- Live-Startgruppe dynamisch, einschließlich aller aktivierten Gruppen.
- Portale, Passwörter, TMDB-Zugang und vorhandene Bilder bleiben erhalten.
- Android-Abnahme auf Box B steht aus.

0.1.29.67
- Live-TV: native TS-/HLS-Erkennung, bewusst wählbares Streamformat und begrenzter, privater Stream-Präfixtest.
- EPG: vorhandener Programmtext bleibt bei optionalen Metadatenfehlern erhalten; gültige Alias- und RAM-Fallbacks quellen- und profilgebunden.
- Kurzes Anbieter-EPG: begrenzte Fehlerabkühlung statt fortlaufender Wiederholungen.
- Sendungsbilder: direkte eigene TMDB-Anbindung, optionaler TVmaze-Fallback und lokale Vorschau im großen und kleinen EPG.
- Offizielles TMDB-Logo nur an tatsächlichen TMDB-Bildern; vollständige Attribution in Credits.
- Portale, Passwörter, Widgets, manuelle Zuordnungen, Cover und Fortschritte bleiben erhalten.
- Android-Abnahme und Ursache des gerätespezifischen HTTP-504-Befunds noch offen; .42-Stop-Modus bleibt erhalten.

0.1.29.66
- EPG: quellenbezogener Neustart-/24-Stunden-Refresh, vollständige lokale Senderabdeckung und lesbare Diagnose.
- Sendungsbilder: konservative Serienauflösung ohne erfundene Folgenangaben; mehrdeutige Treffer und fehlende Bilder klar unterscheiden.
- BINGIE: kontrollierte lokale Fokusrahmen auch für fremde Widgetreihen; Textbereich begrenzen. Skinänderung nur nach Vorschau und ausdrücklicher Zustimmung.
- Portale, Passwörter, EPG-Zuordnungen, Widgets, Cover und Wiedergabefortschritte bleiben erhalten.
- Testkandidat; reale Android-Abnahme noch offen.

0.1.29.65
- Sicherer Token-Zielzugriff über Kodis Profilanker, präzise Fehlercodes und ausdrückliche Wiederherstellung.
- Vollständige Film-/Seriengruppen, nachvollziehbarer Indexstatus und robuste Importwarteschlange.
- Schnellere lokale EPG-Textanzeige und Schutz gültiger Now/Next-Snapshots.
- Portale, Passwörter, Widgets, Bilder, EPG-Zuordnungen und Fortschritte bleiben erhalten.

0.1.29.64
- BINGIE: Film-/Serienfokus an die jeweilige Kachel gebunden; Live-Senderleiste bleibt erhalten.
- Serien-Veröffentlichung nutzt die gemeinsame Provider-Bildreferenz und löst Aktualisierungen bei fertigen Postern aus.
- Hero: längere Titel lesbar; originales Space-Motiv bei fehlendem Sendungsbild.
- Bereits vorbereitete lokale EPG-Texte bleiben bei RAM-Cache-Verdrängung erhalten; Fokus im bestehenden Vorladen priorisiert.
- TMDB-Import mit getrennten Schreibphasen und Inhaltsprüfung nach atomarer Übernahme; Synchronisierungswarnungen verständlich melden.
- Token, Passwörter, Portale, Widgets, Cover und Wiedergabefortschritte bleiben erhalten.
- Android-Abnahme für Box B noch offen; keine Änderungen an Box A.

0.1.29.63
- BINGIE-Hero: bildfüllendes Breitbild mit transparentem Textoverlay gemäß bestätigtem Layout.
- Jetzt/Danach wird aus der gemeinsamen lokalen EPG-Datenbank geladen und warm an den Player übergeben.
- EPG-Text bleibt unabhängig von optionalen Bild-/Metadatenfehlern sichtbar.
- TMDB-Tokendateien können ausdrücklich über Kodi-VFS von USB/SMB lokal importiert werden.
- Getrennte Aktion für Import mit freiwilliger Aktivierung der Sendungsbilder; maskierte Eingabe als Alternative.
- Token, Passwörter, Portale und bestehende Widgets bleiben über das Update erhalten.
- Bekanntes BINGIE-Layout mit Vorschau, Zustimmung, Backup und Wiederherstellung aktualisierbar.

0.1.29.62
- Live-TV-Home liest die konfigurierte Startgruppe direkt aus einer lokalen Kataloggeneration.
- Senderbuttons bleiben bei fehlendem EPG, Artwork-Fehlern und beschädigten Zusatzmetadaten bedienbar.
- Stufendiagnose und streng auf die aktuelle Gruppe beschränkter LastGood-Fallback.
- TMDB-Menü: sichtbares Zurück ohne Einstellungsänderung; Aktivieren und Deaktivieren getrennt.
- Sicherer Import lokaler Kodi-/Datei-URIs; Token und Passwörter bleiben privat erhalten.
- Skinshortcuts-Python-Kompatibilität nur nach gesonderter Vorschau und Bestätigung reparierbar.

0.1.29.61
- Sichtbarer Zugang zur BINGIE-Widgetverwaltung in Aussehen und Darstellung.
- Layoutvorschau, ausdrückliche Zustimmung und Wiederherstellung direkt mit OK.
- Kontrollierte einmalige Skinshortcuts-Neugenerierung bei vorhandenem Adapter.
- TMDB-Zugang unter EPG: private Token-Datei importieren, Formatstatus und Verbindung testen.

- Import aktiviert Sendungsbilder nicht automatisch; Token bleibt bei Neustart und Updates erhalten.
- Gespeicherte Widgetquellen, Film-/Serienreihen und Live-TV-Kompatibilitätsmodus erhalten.

0.1.29.60
- Live-TV-Startgruppenquelle: vollständige Senderreihenfolge auch bei älteren Widget-URLs; BINGIE-Adapter nur nach ausdrücklicher Bestätigung mit Sicherung und Rücknahme.

- Film-/Serienwidgets, gespeicherte Quellen, EPG-Import und bestätigte Stop-Rückkehr aus .59 bleiben erhalten.

0.1.29.59
- Anbieter-EPG: Jetzt aktualisieren bleibt unabhängig von offener Wizard-Einrichtung erreichbar.

- Live-TV: nach bestätigtem Stop auf sichere GUI-Freigabe warten; kein dauerhafter Rückkehrfehler durch abgelaufene Stop-Frist.

0.1.29.58

- Film-/Serienwidgets: ausschließlich Provider-Metadaten und -Bilder, gespeicherte manuelle Korrekturen bleiben erhalten.

0.1.29.57
- Sendungsbilder automatisch über den installierten TMDb Helper vorbereiten, ohne eigenen XCMate-API-Token.
- Eindeutige Film-/Serienidentität prüfen; vorhandene Katalogbilder bevorzugen, Episodenbilder und gekennzeichneten Serienbild-Ersatz unterscheiden.

0.1.29.56
- Bestehender Ordner Widgets und sämtliche Widget-Routen/URLs bleiben erhalten.
- Film-/Serienwidgets lesen Kataloge auch bei blockierter Snapshot-Speicherung; typgerechte Serienmetadaten und Poster.
- Live-Grundreihe bleibt bei fehlenden Sendungsbildern und EPG-Fehlern mit Sendernamen/Logos sichtbar.
- Gemeinsame Sendungsbilder: auch angekündigte Filme vorab vorbereiten; dieselbe gespeicherte Bildadresse für EPG und Hero.
- Klare Bilddiagnose; eingefrorener Wizard, Passwörter, Portale, Fortschritte und Live-TV-Zurück bleiben erhalten.

0.1.29.55
- Widgets: drei direkte Quellen im nativen BINGIE-Picker unter XCMate > Widgets.

- Live-Navigation: verwaiste Übergabesperre lösen und wartende eigene Übergabe mit Zurück abbrechen.
- Wizard .54 und gespeicherte Passwörter, Portale, EPG, Cover und Profile bleiben erhalten.

0.1.29.54
- Installation erfolgreich: Popup zeigt installierte Version und konkrete Änderungen.
- Wizard prüft die Verbindung getrennt und bestätigt gültige Zugangsdaten.
- Geprüfte Kataloggruppen inkrementell sichern und beim Retry wiederverwenden.
- Portal vor optionalem EPG speichern; Inhalte bleiben bei EPG-Fehlern nutzbar.
- EPG-Quellen einzeln validieren, speichern und im Manager fortsetzen.
- Keine feste Gesamtdauer aktiver EPG-Importe; echte Byte-/Sendungszähler.

0.1.29.53
- Update-Popup zeigt die konkreten EPG-/Wizard-Änderungen und das tatsächliche Passwortverhalten.
- Zentraler EPG-Manager: Quellen, echte Zeiträume und lesbare Aktualisierungsberichte.
- Quellqualifizierte Live-Vorschau im originalen Raster bei offenem Auswahlpanel.
- 24 Stunden Standardrefresh; bestehende Intervalle und LastGood bleiben erhalten.
- Gezielte, begrenzte Quellen-Retries statt permanentem Überspringen oder Voll-Neustart.
- Wiederaufnehmbarer Wizard mit privaten Zwischenständen, Zurück, Retry und bestätigtem Verwerfen.
- Neue Passworteingabe sichtbar oder verdeckt; gespeicherte Passwörter niemals vorzeigen.
- .50/.52-Widgets und Pixelanzeige erhalten; BINGIE-Skinpatch nur separat freigegeben.
- Android-Abnahme offen; kein automatischer Merge, Geräteupdate oder Datenreset.

0.1.29.52
- EPG: einheitliches 7/20-Kalendertage-Fenster im Master und gemeinsamen Datenbestand.
- Quellqualifizierte Lücken-/Metadaten-Ergänzung mit bewahrtem Last-Good-Bestand.
- Nachträglicher Seriengruppenimport mit Wiederanlauf, Fortschritt und Abbruch.
- Gerahmte echte Stream-Pixelauflösung; Übergangswerte bleiben unbekannt.
- Keine Daten-/Profilresets, keine Skinmodifikation; Android-Abnahme offen.

0.1.29.51
- Wizard: bestätigte Übernahme der neuen Portal-Settings, fehlende Angaben ergänzen.
- Gruppenlisten lazy und in begrenzten Owner-Pump-Schritten; Auswahl ohne Add-on-Abfragen pro Zeile.
- Neutrale Wizard-Schaltflächen, sichtbarer Fortschritt, sichere Abbruch-/Worker-Sperre.
- Bestehende Portale, Daten und Live-TV-/BINGIE-Funktionen unverändert. Android-Abnahme offen.

0.1.29.50 (explicit BINGIE Home integration; Android NOT_TESTED)
- #252: three direct Live TV / Movies / Series choices prepare a verified native
  Skinshortcuts Home slot. Preserve occupied movie/series bindings and reload hooks.
  Explicit confirmation, private original/candidate SHA256, safe restore.
- Four-file opt-in BINGIE 2.2.3 adapter: real Home programme Hero and small
  horizontal station logos, plus direct native widget candidates. No automatic
  skin/profile modification, startup apply or native player rewrite.
- Live Home reads only the explicitly configured start group from the shared local
  EPG/artwork data. Full group, no provider/category fallback, focus never tunes.
- Prior widget source folders and .48 preview remain compatibility functions.

0.1.29.49 (widget selection hotfix #252; Android NOT_TESTED)
- Settings > Appearance and display > Widgets lists three real folders:
  Live TV - start group, Movies - latest movies, Series - latest series.
- BINGIE/skinshortcuts can browse and select the existing widget endpoints;
  the skin's own picker saves the binding. No plugin-URL textviewer substitute.
- Correct German menu names, explicit native save instructions, and compatibility
  for bookmarked RunPlugin entries. Existing status/Hero preview remain separate.
- No skin/profile edits or widget URL/reload-hook changes; preserve all .48 data,
  media widgets and their automatic refresh. No automatic installation or merge.

0.1.29.48 (cumulative review candidate; Android .48 NOT_TESTED)
- #250/#249: OS-held service singleton, local-first startup phases, bounded
  maintenance and optional network prefetch. No claim of a proven native
  Android crash fix without a crash/ANR trace and device acceptance.
- Wizard: direct setup entry without full router/root reloading; stale owner
  protection, finite native-init/discovery deadlines, 3s request timeout and no
  discovery retries. Xtream authentication now makes one request, not two.
- Wizard Save preserves committed EPG source archive, XMLTV images, cast,
  director and additive common facts; external-only sources retain correct rank.
  Existing populated guides remain behind the verified-backup gate.
- Preserve the .42 native Live Stop strategy. Pending exit has service priority;
  completed exits do not starve movie/widget refresh. Home-origin playback
  returns to Kodi Home without recursively dispatching the plugin root.
- Source-qualified EPG assignment directly from Guide context or visible button:
  real grid preview in RAM, explicit Save/Cancel, legacy mapping compatibility.
- Propagate verified rich event data, protect direct XMLTV icons from nested
  rating icons, rotate event-art jobs independently of widget repaint, require
  the image decoder dependency and add bounded privacy-safe evidence.
- Covermanager uses existing candidates immediately, supports verified offline
  choices and explicit provider refresh; safe credentialless public image
  redirects revalidate DNS/TLS, deny downgrade/private hosts and limit hops.
- Native Live-only sender-strip/large-Hero preview. Optional BINGIE include is
  REVIEW_ONLY / BLOCKED_SKIN_INTEGRATION pending actual skin review/approval.
  Working movie/series widgets, native click paths and reload hooks unchanged.
- No reset, no existing image deletion, no device action, no auto-merge/release.

0.1.29.47 (cumulative review candidate; Android .47 NOT_TESTED)
- #244/#245: movie payloads use complete primary-key seeks, with one pinned
  read-only transaction and a strict active-SQL budget. Cold imports no longer
  consume a query deadline; the successful series SQL/data contract is retained.
- Reject only superseded derived movie snapshots; real Empty/Unavailable is
  not rendered as a fake XCMate film tile. Numeric movie InfoTags normalized.
- Keep genuine station images in native Live tiles when programme artwork is
  absent; preserve the separate programme picture/logo properties and all
  88 Android-confirmed start-group senders. No automatic BINGIE skin changes.
- Shared .46 SQLite gains additive channel/asset/diagnostic references. Existing
  guide, settings, mappings, images and manual-choice manifests remain intact.
  Dynamic movie covers stay dynamic; no new persistent provider cover archive.
- Page-scoped thread-local read snapshots and background channel/index models
  remove repeated database reconnections and GUI catalog construction.
- Common event IDs survive Guide/Mini/Infobar/Widget reads and RAM Now/Next
  rollover. Verified existing programme facts remain available as LastGood.
- Explicit cover Save mirrors an extension-correct verified display reference
  into the common layer while preserving the original chosen image.
- Independent widget failure handling, private count/stage diagnostics and
  exact population/decoder limitations. References are not a rendering PASS.
- Re-check the committed return latch before Home; transient missing InfoTag
  after confirmed native Stop cannot authorize a second Stop or foreign exit.
- Native .42 Stop/compatibility engine, autoplay, resume, IR/keymaps, seven
  settings and PIN 6666 retained. No refresh without verified EPG backup.

0.1.29.46 (cumulative review candidate; Android .46 NOT_TESTED)
- Latest direct user instruction includes the already implemented shared
  programme_artwork.sqlite conversion in .46 after complete regression checks.
  Own WAL/app-ID cache, incremental facts/DTOs/art references and real feed
  history through day-7/day+20; no expansion/reset of the primary guide schema.
- Verified 16:9 local artwork, source confidence/positive and negative TTL,
  content reuse, crash rollback and distinct cache/budget diagnostics.
- #241/#240: preserve native Stop timeout as failure; recover the GUI once a
  matching late FIFO return is verified, no second Stop or foreign navigation.
- Skip fully superseded/empty legacy movie groups before the bounded widget
  query; preserve policy-valid LastGood on Busy/Budget, with safe stage codes.
- Full Live start group, generation-pinned keyset reads and 16-channel EPG
  batches; paged atomic Home publications and bounded rotating/focus artwork.
- Prime optional service imports outside the input owner; RAM-only widget
  notifications, fast stable-profile reads and early start-group snapshots.
- Real graphical cover/metadata candidate grid with local validated thumbnails,
  role filters and larger preview; explicit Save/persist/cancel kept.
- Verify actual EPG backup receipt before auto/manual refresh of a populated
  guide. Read-only diagnosis stays available without migration or data reset.
- Anonymous route/video/mini/group and media/detail/resolve phase markers;
  Android cold/warm p50/p95 remain NOT_TESTED, native deadlock not claimed fixed.
- Shared local programme details and Live widget event identity, metadata, image
  provenance and neutral fallbacks. Station-logo overlays remain separate images.
- Graphical programme view from the large guide and existing mini/programme info
  paths; exact Live widget context-info target, unchanged sender OK targets.
- Rich XMLTV event facts retained in a bounded separate staged cache, published
  only after the authoritative source commit. No guide schema migration/reset.
- Bounded asynchronous event-art cache; exact opt-in TMDb title/year/episode
  matching, negative TTLs and verified persistent local images.
- Optional hash-guarded BINGIE programme-card adapter prepared with per-card
  logo/title/times/progress and focused description. Never applied automatically.
  Missing reload/overlay/focus hooks remain BLOCKED, not full widget acceptance.
- Existing movie/series widget routes, seven settings, PIN 6666, reference
  infobar, live compatibility stop, autoplay/resume and all user data retained.

0.1.29.45 (cumulative review candidate; Android .45 NOT_TESTED)
- Existing Home widget rows refresh from atomic local data publications without
  rebinding URLs, changing skin files or scanning unrelated Kodi libraries.
- Seven settings sections; exact PIN 6666 for each experimental entry and deep
  links. Legacy setting IDs/values and safe route aliases retained.
- Local central menu icons across owned menus/dialogs; unchanged focus IDs.
- Reference three-column first infobar: channel/date/time, previous/current/next
  EPG and six actual stream fields. Existing owner-bound 2s sampler unchanged.
- .44 EPG backup/import protection, live compatibility stop, search, media,
  autoplay and resume retained. No device access, data reset or auto-merge.

0.1.29.44 (Android A-H review candidate; all .44 Android gates NOT_TESTED)

class Router:
    def __init__(self, argv):
        self._handle = int(argv[1])
        self._base   = argv[0]
        args = argv[2][1:] if len(argv) > 2 else ''
        self._params = dict(urllib.parse.parse_qsl(args, keep_blank_values=True))

    def url(self, **kw):
        return self._base + '?' + urllib.parse.urlencode(
            {k: v for k, v in kw.items() if v is not None},
            quote_via=urllib.parse.quote
        )

    def dispatch(self):
        from experimental45 import protected,active,route
        if protected(self._params) and not active():return route(self,self.dispatch)
        from boot_diagnostics import phase, mark
        action = self._params.get('action', 'root')
        from setup_navigation import active as wizard_active
        if action in ('root','portal_home','xcmate_home') and wizard_active():
            self._end_directory(succeeded=False,cacheToDisc=False);return
        # Log a route before imports/settings work; arbitrary query text is not logged.
        mark('ROUTE', action=action)
        from window_lifecycle import route_phase
        route_phase(self,'ENTRY',action)
        with phase('PORTALS_IMPORT'):
            import portals as _portals_mod
        # No migration/settings writes on every root or parallel widget request.
        # Legacy settings can be imported explicitly from the empty-profile menu.

        R = {
            'root'               : self._root,
            'app_open'           : self._app_open,
            'import_legacy_settings': self._import_legacy_settings,
            'portal_manager'     : self._portal_manager,
            'portal_home'        : self._portal_home,
            'live_groups'        : self._live_groups,
            'm3u_movies'         : self._m3u_movies,
            'm3u_series'         : self._m3u_series,

            'recent_series'      : self._recent_series,
            'widget_groups'      : self._widget_groups,
            'widget_channels'    : self._widget_channels,
            'media_details'      : self._media_details,
            'trailer'            : self._trailer,
            'vod_categories'     : self._vod_categories,
            'vod_list'           : self._vod_list,
            'series_categories'  : self._series_categories,
            'series_list'        : self._series_list,
            'series_seasons'     : self._series_seasons,
            'series_episodes'    : self._series_episodes,

            'search_results'     : self._search_results,
            'epg_now'            : self._epg_now,
            'epg_status'         : self._epg_status,
            'epg_channel'        : self._epg_channel,
            'epg_sources'        : self._epg_sources,

            'popup_probe': self._popup_probe,
            'autoplay_diagnostic_mode': self._autoplay_diagnostic_mode,
        }
        from app_routes import ACTIONS
        R.update({name:self._app_route for name in ACTIONS})
        try:
            if action in ('root', 'portal_home', 'xcmate_home'):
                with phase('ROOT_MENU'):

    def _portal_plot(self, p: dict, extra: str = '', cached_only=False) -> str:
        import datetime as _dt2
        ptype = p.get('type', 'm3u')
        type_map = {'m3u': 'M3U Playlist', 'xtream': 'Xtream Codes', 'stb': 'STB / Stalker Portal'}
        lines = [f'[B]{p.get("name", "?")}[/B]  [{type_map.get(ptype, ptype.upper())}]', '']

        if ptype == 'm3u':
            if p.get('m3u_url'):
                lines.append('[B]URL:[/B]  [gespeichert]')
            if p.get('epg_url'):
                lines.append(f'[B]EPG:[/B]  {p["epg_url"]}')
            from portals import detect_xtream
            _xc_creds = detect_xtream(p.get('m3u_url', ''))
            if _xc_creds and not cached_only:
                try:
                    from xtream import XtreamClient
                    _xc = XtreamClient(_xc_creds['xc_host'], _xc_creds['xc_user'], _xc_creds['xc_pass'])
                    _ui = _xc.get_user_info()
                    _si = _xc.get_server_info()
                    if _ui:
                        lines.append('')
                        lines.append('[B]── Account-Info ──[/B]')
                        _status = _ui.get('status', '?')
                        _auth   = _ui.get('auth', 0)
                        lines.append(f'[B]Status:[/B]  {_status}  |  Auth: {"✔" if _auth else "✘"}')
                        if _ui.get('exp_date'):
                            try:
                                _exp = _dt2.datetime.fromtimestamp(int(_ui['exp_date']))
                                _days_left = (_exp - _dt2.datetime.now()).days
                                lines.append(f'[B]Läuft ab:[/B]  {_exp.strftime("%d.%m.%Y")}  ({_days_left} Tage)')
                            except Exception:
                                lines.append(f'[B]Läuft ab:[/B]  {_ui["exp_date"]}')
                        if _ui.get('max_connections'):
                            lines.append(f'[B]Max. Verbindungen:[/B]  {_ui["max_connections"]}')
                        if _ui.get('active_cons') is not None:
                            lines.append(f'[B]Aktive Verbindungen:[/B]  {_ui["active_cons"]}')
                        if _ui.get('is_trial') in ('1', 1, True):
                            lines.append('[B]Trial-Account[/B]')
                        if _ui.get('allowed_output_formats'):
                            lines.append(f'[B]Formate:[/B]  {", ".join(_ui["allowed_output_formats"])}')
                    if _si:
                        lines.append('')
                        lines.append('[B]── Server-Info ──[/B]')
                        if _si.get('timezone'):
                            lines.append(f'[B]Zeitzone:[/B]  {_si["timezone"]}')
                        if _si.get('server_protocol'):
                            lines.append(f'[B]Protokoll:[/B]  {_si["server_protocol"]}')
                        if _si.get('https_port'):
                            lines.append(f'[B]HTTPS-Port:[/B]  {_si["https_port"]}')
                        if _si.get('rtmp_port'):
                            lines.append(f'[B]RTMP-Port:[/B]  {_si["rtmp_port"]}')
                except Exception as e:
                    lines.append(f'[I](Account-Info nicht verfügbar: {e})[/I]')

        elif ptype == 'xtream':
            host = p.get('xc_host', '')
            user = p.get('xc_user', '')
            pwd  = p.get('xc_pass', '')
            if host:
                lines.append(f'[B]Server:[/B]  {host}')
            if user:
                lines.append(f'[B]Benutzer:[/B]  {user}')
            if pwd:
                lines.append('[B]Passwort:[/B]  ••••••••')
            if p.get('epg_url'):
                lines.append(f'[B]EPG:[/B]  {p["epg_url"]}')
            if host and user and not cached_only:
                try:
                    from xtream import XtreamClient
                    xc = XtreamClient(host, user, pwd)
                    ui = xc.get_user_info()
                    si = xc.get_server_info()
                    if ui:
                        lines.append('')
                        lines.append('[B]── Account-Info ──[/B]')
                        status = ui.get('status', '?')
                        auth   = ui.get('auth', 0)
                        lines.append(f'[B]Status:[/B]  {status}  |  Auth: {"✔" if auth else "✘"}')
                        if ui.get('exp_date'):
                            try:
                                exp = _dt2.datetime.fromtimestamp(int(ui['exp_date']))
                                days_left = (exp - _dt2.datetime.now()).days
                                lines.append(f'[B]Läuft ab:[/B]  {exp.strftime("%d.%m.%Y")}  ({days_left} Tage)')
                            except Exception:
                                lines.append(f'[B]Läuft ab:[/B]  {ui["exp_date"]}')
                        if ui.get('max_connections'):
                            lines.append(f'[B]Max. Verbindungen:[/B]  {ui["max_connections"]}')
                        if ui.get('active_cons') is not None:
                            lines.append(f'[B]Aktive Verbindungen:[/B]  {ui["active_cons"]}')
                        if ui.get('is_trial') in ('1', 1, True):
                            lines.append('[B]Trial-Account[/B]')
                        if ui.get('allowed_output_formats'):
                            fmts = ', '.join(ui['allowed_output_formats'])
                            lines.append(f'[B]Formate:[/B]  {fmts}')
                    if si:
                        lines.append('')
                        lines.append('[B]── Server-Info ──[/B]')
                        if si.get('timezone'):
                            lines.append(f'[B]Zeitzone:[/B]  {si["timezone"]}')
                        if si.get('server_protocol'):
                            lines.append(f'[B]Protokoll:[/B]  {si["server_protocol"]}')
                        if si.get('https_port'):
                            lines.append(f'[B]HTTPS-Port:[/B]  {si["https_port"]}')
                        if si.get('rtmp_port'):
                            lines.append(f'[B]RTMP-Port:[/B]  {si["rtmp_port"]}')
                except Exception as e:
                    lines.append(f'[I](Account-Info nicht verfügbar: {e})[/I]')

        elif ptype == 'stb':
            if p.get('stb_url'):
                lines.append(f'[B]URL:[/B]  {p["stb_url"]}')
            if p.get('stb_mac'):
                lines.append(f'[B]MAC:[/B]  {p["stb_mac"]}')
            if p.get('epg_url'):
                lines.append(f'[B]EPG:[/B]  {p["epg_url"]}')
            if p.get('stb_url') and p.get('stb_mac') and not cached_only:
                try:
                    from stalker import client_for_portal
                    stb = client_for_portal(p)
                    info_d = stb.get_account_info() if stb else {}
                    if info_d:
                        lines.append('')
                        lines.append('[B]── Account-Info ──[/B]')
                        if info_d.get('status'):
                            lines.append(f'[B]Status:[/B]  {info_d["status"]}')
                        if info_d.get('tariff_plan_name'):
                            lines.append(f'[B]Paket:[/B]  {info_d["tariff_plan_name"]}')
                        if info_d.get('end_date'):
                            try:
                                exp = _dt2.datetime.strptime(info_d['end_date'], '%Y-%m-%d')
                                days_left = (exp - _dt2.datetime.now()).days
                                lines.append(f'[B]Läuft ab:[/B]  {exp.strftime("%d.%m.%Y")}  ({days_left} Tage)')
                            except Exception:
                                lines.append(f'[B]Läuft ab:[/B]  {info_d["end_date"]}')
                        if info_d.get('max_connections'):
                            lines.append(f'[B]Max. Verbindungen:[/B]  {info_d["max_connections"]}')
                        if info_d.get('active_con') is not None:
                            lines.append(f'[B]Aktive Verbindungen:[/B]  {info_d["active_con"]}')
                        _pv = info_d.get('phone', '')
                        if _pv:
                            import re as _rep
                            _pv_norm = _rep.sub(r'\b(am|pm)\b', lambda m: m.group().upper(), _pv.strip(), flags=_rep.IGNORECASE)
                            _matched = False
                            for _fmt in ('%B %d, %Y, %I:%M %p', '%B %d, %Y, %-I:%M %p', '%B %d, %Y',
                                         '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', '%Y-%m-%d', '%d.%m.%Y'):
                                try:
                                    import datetime as _dtp
                                    _exp = _dtp.datetime.strptime(_pv_norm, _fmt)
                                    _days = (_exp - _dtp.datetime.now()).days
                                    lines.append(f'[B]Läuft ab:[/B]  {_exp.strftime("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M")}  ({_days} Tage)')
                                    _matched = True
                                    break
                                except Exception:
                                    pass
                            if not _matched:
                                lines.append(f'[B]Läuft ab:[/B]  {_pv}')
                except Exception as e:
                    lines.append(f'[I](Account-Info nicht verfügbar: {e})[/I]')

        lines.append('')
        if p.get('created'):
            try:
                c = _dt2.datetime.fromtimestamp(int(p['created'])).strftime('%d.%m.%Y %H:%M')
                lines.append(f'[B]Erstellt:[/B]  {c}')
            except Exception:
                pass
        if p.get('updated'):
            try:
                u = _dt2.datetime.fromtimestamp(int(p['updated'])).strftime('%d.%m.%Y %H:%M')
                lines.append(f'[B]Zuletzt aktualisiert:[/B]  {u}')
            except Exception:
                pass

        if extra:
            lines += ['', extra]
        return '\n'.join(lines)

    def _app_open(self):
        if self._handle>=0:return self._root()
        self._end_directory(cacheToDisc=False)
        xbmc.executebuiltin('ActivateWindow(Videos,'+self.url(action='root')+',return)')

    def _root(self):
        import portals as P
        active = P.get_active()
        xbmcplugin.setPluginCategory(self._handle, _L(32000))
        xbmcplugin.setContent(self._handle, '')

        if not active:
            from window_navigation import add_action
            add_action(self,'[+] Einrichtungsassistent starten',
                          self.url(action='setup_wizard'),
                          icon=_ICON_SETTINGS)
            self._add_dir('Vorhandene Playlists aus Einstellungen übernehmen',
                          self.url(action='import_legacy_settings'), icon=_ICON_SETTINGS)
            self._add_dir(_L(32060),
                          self.url(action='portal_manager'),
                          icon=_ICON_SETTINGS,
                          plot='Kein Portal konfiguriert. Hier ein neues Portal hinzufügen.')
            self._add_dir(_L(32007), self.url(action='settings'),
                          icon=_ICON_SETTINGS,
                          plot='Addon-Einstellungen öffnen.')
            self._end_directory()
            from setup_navigation import maybe_fresh
            maybe_fresh(self)
            return

        from home_menu import active_portal
        portal = active_portal(active, self._params.get('pid',''))
        self._show_portal_home(portal)
        self._maybe_autoplay_start(portal)

    def _startup_playable(self):
        """Resolve only the configured stream, never refresh portal catalogs here.

        Return a Kodi ListItem with the provider URL in its path. The caller
        decides whether Kodi expects a resolved playable item or a direct play.
        """
        from live_timing import begin,emit
        timing=begin(self)
        from portals import get_by_id
        p = get_by_id(self._params.get('pid', ''))
        if not p or p.get('type') != 'xtream' or not p.get('start_stream_id'):
            notify('XCMate', 'Bitte zuerst eine Startgruppe und einen Startsender wählen.')
            return None
        from xtream import XtreamClient
        from player import build_playable_item
        sid = str(p['start_stream_id'])
        xc = XtreamClient(p['xc_host'], p['xc_user'], p['xc_pass'])
        from live_start import channel as start_channel
        if hasattr(self,'_start_channel'):
            channel = self._start_channel
        else:
            emit(timing,'PORTAL_REQUEST_BEGIN',network=0)
            channel = start_channel(p,xc)
            emit(timing,'PORTAL_REQUEST_END',network=0)
        if channel is None:
            notify('XCMate', 'Startsender ist nicht im aktivierten lokalen Katalog verfügbar.')
            return None
        emit(timing,'START_SID_RESOLVED',ready=1)
        url = xc.live_stream_url(sid, __import__('live_format67').extension())
        if not url:
            notify('XCMate', 'Die Startsender-Adresse konnte nicht ermittelt werden.')
            return None
        title = channel.get('name') or 'Startsender'
        item = build_playable_item(url, title=title,
                                   logo=channel.get('stream_icon', ''),live67=True)
        return p, sid, title, item

    def _play_start(self):
        """Kodi playable menu entry: resolve, never open an empty directory.

        A ListItem with IsPlayable=true invokes Kodi's playback handshake.
        Calling Player.play() here leaves the pending plugin URL unresolved.
        """
        from live_exit import _trace
        _trace('START_RESOLVER')
        prepared = self._startup_playable()
        if prepared is None:
            xbmcplugin.setResolvedUrl(self._handle, False, xbmcgui.ListItem())
            return
        p, sid, title, item = prepared
        from live_overlay import announce
        try:
            session=announce(p['id'], sid, title)
            from live_timing import bind,emit
            bind(self._live_timing,session)
            from play_intent import before_play
            if not before_play(session):
                xbmcplugin.setResolvedUrl(self._handle, False, xbmcgui.ListItem())
                return
            from live_recovery import tag_live_item
            tag_live_item(item,session)
            xbmcgui.Window(10000).setProperty(
                'XtreamMate.StartupStatus', 'Kodi-Auflösung: ' + title[:64])
            emit(self._live_timing,'PLAY_INVOKED')
            xbmcplugin.setResolvedUrl(self._handle, True, item)
        except Exception as exc:
            error('XCMate startup resolver failed: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__))
            notify('XCMate', 'Startsender konnte nicht gestartet werden.')
            xbmcgui.Window(10000).setProperty(
                'XtreamMate.StartupStatus', 'Fehler: ' + type(exc).__name__)
            xbmcplugin.setResolvedUrl(self._handle, False, xbmcgui.ListItem())

    def _play_start_direct(self):
        """RunPlugin-only direct startup with fresh ownership checks."""
        from app_entry import accept_play,still_allowed
        if not accept_play(self._params):return

        from live_exit import _trace
        _trace('START_RESOLVER')
        prepared = self._startup_playable()
        if prepared is None:
            return
        p, sid, title, item = prepared
        if not still_allowed(self._params):return
        from live_overlay import announce
        try:
            session=announce(p['id'], sid, title)
            from live_timing import bind,emit
            bind(self._live_timing,session)
            from play_intent import before_play
            if not before_play(session): return
            if not still_allowed(self._params):
                xbmcgui.Window(10000).setProperty('XCMate.PrePlay.Cancel',session['nonce'])
                xbmcgui.Window(10000).setProperty('XtreamMate.StartupStatus','AUTOPLAY_BLOCKED_FOREIGN_OR_PREFERENCE')
                return
            from live_recovery import tag_live_item
            tag_live_item(item,session)
            xbmcgui.Window(10000).setProperty(
                'XtreamMate.StartupStatus', 'Autoplay-Direktstart: ' + title[:64])
            emit(self._live_timing,'PLAY_INVOKED')
            xbmc.Player().play(item.getPath(), item)
        except Exception as exc:
            error('XCMate direct startup failed: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__))
            notify('XCMate', 'Startsender konnte nicht gestartet werden.')
            xbmcgui.Window(10000).setProperty(
                'XtreamMate.StartupStatus', 'Fehler: ' + type(exc).__name__)

    def _live_channels(self):
        p = self._portal()
        if not p:
            return
        group   = self._params.get('group', '')
        page    = int(self._params.get('page', 0))
        psize   = setting_int('items_per_page', 50)
        all_ch  = self._load_channels(p)
        if p.get('type') == 'xtream':
            from group_selection import filter_channels
            all_ch = filter_channels(all_ch, p['id'])
        ch_list = [c for c in all_ch if c.group == group] if group else all_ch

        s = setting_int('sort_channels')
        if s == 1:
            ch_list.sort(key=lambda c: c.name.lower())
        elif s == 2:
            ch_list.sort(key=lambda c: c.name.lower(), reverse=True)
        ch_list = apply_lang_sort(ch_list)

        total   = len(ch_list)
        chunk   = ch_list[page * psize:(page + 1) * psize]

        xbmcplugin.setContent(self._handle, 'videos')
        label = group or _L(32015)
        if total > psize:
            label = f'{label}  ({page * psize + 1}-{min((page + 1) * psize, total)} / {total})'
        xbmcplugin.setPluginCategory(self._handle, label)

        ptype   = p.get('type', 'm3u')
        from player import channel_list_item
        from epg import load_cache
        from epg_views import resolve_guide, prefetch_short_guides
        guide = load_cache(p['id'])
        xc_epg = self._xc(p) if ptype == 'xtream' else None
        manual_epg = {}
        if xc_epg:
            from epg_sources import configuration
            manual_epg = configuration(p['id'])['mappings']
            prefetch_short_guides(p, chunk,view_path=self.url(action='live_channels',
                                  pid=p['id'],group=group,page=page))
        now = time.time()
        matched=now_count=next_count=0
        for ch in chunk:
            li = channel_list_item(ch)
            epg = resolve_guide(guide, ch.tvg_id, ch.extra.get('stream_id',''),
                                now, xc_epg, manual_epg)
            now_count+=bool(epg['now'])
            next_count+=bool(epg['next'])
            matched+=bool(epg['now'] or epg['next'])
            from epg_views import programme_plot
            li.setInfo('video', {'title':ch.name, 'plot':programme_plot(epg),
                                 'mediatype':'video'})
            if epg['now'] or epg['next']:
                li.setLabel('{}  |  Jetzt: {}  |  Danach: {}'.format(
                    ch.name, '{}-{} {}'.format(epg['now_time'],epg['now_end_time'],epg['now'])
                    if epg['now'] else 'Keine EPG-Daten',epg['next'] or '–'))

            if ptype == 'stb':
                play_url  = self.url(action='play_stb_live', pid=p['id'],
                                     cmd=ch.url, name=ch.name, logo=ch.logo)
                cu_action = 'stb_catchup_list'
            else:
                play_url  = self.url(action='play_live', pid=p['id'],
                                     sid=ch.extra.get('stream_id', ''),
                                     url=ch.url, name=ch.name, logo=ch.logo)

    def _widget_channels(self):
        """Widget-friendly static directory. No network calls during Kodi hover."""
        p = self._portal()
        if not p:
            return
        if p.get('type') != 'xtream' or not p.get('include_live', True):
            xbmcplugin.endOfDirectory(self._handle, False)
            return
        from group_selection import enabled_ids
        from epg import load_cache
        from epg_views import guide_for_channel, programme_plot
        xc = self._xc(p)
        groups = xc.get_cached_catalog('get_live_categories') if xc else None
        streams = xc.get_cached_catalog('get_live_streams') if xc else None
        if not isinstance(groups, list) or not isinstance(streams, list):
            self._add_dir('Senderkatalog lädt im Hintergrund',
                          self.url(action='widget_channels', pid=p['id'],
                                   cat_id=self._params.get('cat_id','')), icon=_ICON_TV)
            xbmcplugin.endOfDirectory(self._handle, cacheToDisc=False)
            return
        allowed = enabled_ids(p['id'], 'live', groups)
        cid = str(self._params.get('cat_id') or '')
        if cid not in allowed:
            xbmcplugin.endOfDirectory(self._handle, False)
            return
        names = {str(g.get('category_id')):str(g.get('category_name') or '')
                 for g in groups if isinstance(g,dict)}
        guide = load_cache(p['id'])
        now_ts = time.time()
        xbmcplugin.setContent(self._handle, 'videos')
        xbmcplugin.setPluginCategory(self._handle, 'XCMate – ' + names.get(cid,'TV'))
        for item in streams:
            if not isinstance(item, dict) or str(item.get('category_id','')) != cid:
                continue
            sid = str(item.get('stream_id') or '')
            if not sid:
                continue
            name = str(item.get('name') or 'Sender')
            logo = str(item.get('stream_icon') or '')
            epg = guide_for_channel(guide, item.get('epg_channel_id',''), sid, now_ts)
            li = xbmcgui.ListItem(name)
            img = epg.get('image') or logo
            li.setArt({'icon':logo, 'thumb':logo, 'poster':img, 'landscape':img,
                       'fanart':img or ADDON_FANART})
            li.setInfo('video', {'title':name, 'plot':programme_plot(epg),
                                 'mediatype':'video'})
            li.setProperty('IsPlayable','true')
            li.setProperty('XtreamMate.Now',epg.get('now',''))
            li.setProperty('XtreamMate.Next',epg.get('next',''))
            xbmcplugin.addDirectoryItem(self._handle,
                self.url(action='play_live', pid=p['id'],sid=sid,name=name,logo=logo),
                li,False)
        xbmcplugin.endOfDirectory(self._handle, cacheToDisc=False)

        p = self._portal()

        kind = self._params.get('kind','vod')
        sid = self._params.get('sid','')
        xc = self._xc(p)

            return
        from metadata_views import enrich, provider_plot, trailer_id
        details = (xc.get_vod_info(sid) if kind == 'vod' else xc.get_series_info(sid))
        item = enrich({}, details)
        plot = provider_plot(item) or 'Der Anbieter liefert keine Beschreibung.'
        vid = trailer_id(item)
        if vid:
            plot += '\n\nYouTube-Trailer-ID: ' + vid
        xbmcgui.Dialog().textviewer('XCMate – Filminfo', plot)
        if vid and xbmcgui.Dialog().yesno('XCMate', 'YouTube-Trailer abspielen?'):
            self._play_youtube_id(vid)

    @staticmethod
    def _play_youtube_id(vid):
        from metadata_views import trailer_id
        from urllib.parse import quote
        if trailer_id({'youtube_trailer':vid}) != vid:
            return
        try:
            xbmcaddon.Addon('plugin.video.youtube')
        except RuntimeError:
            xbmcgui.Dialog().ok('XCMate',
                'Bitte das offizielle Kodi-YouTube-Add-on installieren, '
                'um Trailer direkt wiederzugeben.')
            return
        xbmc.executebuiltin('PlayMedia(plugin://plugin.video.youtube/play/?video_id={})'.format(quote(vid)))

        self._play_youtube_id(self._params.get('vid',''))

    def _recent_media(self, action, kind):
        """Widget-ready Kodi directory populated from the cached Xtream index.

        Neither the home screen nor the latest view blocks on Xtream requests.
        The Kodi service warms the catalog in the background; refresh from
        the portal home is available if the IPTV provider has added new titles.
        """
        p = self._portal()
        if not p:
            return
        wanted = 'include_vod' if kind == 'vod' else 'include_series'
        if p.get('type') != 'xtream' or not p.get(wanted, True):
            xbmcplugin.endOfDirectory(self._handle, False)
            return
        from group_selection import filter_entries
        from latest_media import first_seen, recent_entries
        from player import vod_list_item, series_list_item
        xc = self._xc(p)
        title = 'Neueste Filme' if kind == 'vod' else 'Neueste Serien'
        xbmcplugin.setPluginCategory(self._handle, '{} – {}'.format(p['name'], title))
        xbmcplugin.setContent(self._handle, 'movies' if kind == 'vod' else 'tvshows')
        all_items = xc.get_cached_catalog(action) if xc else None
        if not isinstance(all_items, list):
            self._add_dir('Katalog wird im Hintergrund geladen – später erneut öffnen',
                          self.url(action='portal_home', pid=p['id']),
                          icon=_ICON_SETTINGS,
                          plot='Beim ersten Scan muss XCMate Daten vom Anbieter laden.')
        else:
            # Cache was present before 0.1.5: initialize its discovery baseline
            # without falsely flagging all previously known items as 'new'.
            seen = first_seen(xc._cache_key(action), action, all_items)
            items = filter_entries(all_items, p['id'], kind)
            recent = recent_entries(items, action, seen, limit=50)
            for item in recent:
                if kind == 'vod':
                    sid = item.get('stream_id', '')
                    li = vod_list_item(item)
                    self._add_media_context(li, item, 'vod', sid, p['id'])
                    url = self.url(action='play_vod', pid=p['id'],
                                   stream_id=sid,
                                   ext=item.get('container_extension', 'mkv'),
                                   title=item.get('name', ''),
                                   logo=item.get('stream_icon', ''))
                    is_folder = False
                else:
                    sid = item.get('series_id', '')
                    li = series_list_item(item)
                    self._add_media_context(li, item, 'series', sid, p['id'])
                    url = self.url(action='series_seasons', pid=p['id'],
                                   series_id=sid, title=item.get('name', ''))
                    is_folder = True
                xbmcplugin.addDirectoryItem(self._handle, url, li, is_folder)
            if not recent:
                self._add_dir('Noch keine neu hinzugefügten Titel erkennbar',
                              self.url(action='portal_home', pid=p['id']),
                              icon=_ICON_SETTINGS,
                              plot='Der Anbieter liefert eventuell kein Hinzufügedatum. '
                                   'XCMate erkennt künftig beim Aktualisieren neue IDs.')
        xbmcplugin.addSortMethod(self._handle, xbmcplugin.SORT_METHOD_NONE)
        xbmcplugin.endOfDirectory(self._handle, cacheToDisc=False)

    def _stb_channels(self):
        p = self._portal()
        if not p:
            return
        genre_id = self._params.get('genre_id', '*')
        stb = self._stb(p)
        if not stb:
            xbmcplugin.endOfDirectory(self._handle, False)
            return
        channels_box = [None]
        epg_box      = [None]

        def _load_channels():
            channels_box[0] = stb.get_live_channels(genre_id)

        def _load_epg():
            epg_box[0] = self._epg_cache(p)

        t1 = threading.Thread(target=_load_channels, daemon=True)
        t2 = threading.Thread(target=_load_epg,      daemon=True)
        t1.start(); t2.start()
        t1.join();  t2.join()

        channels = apply_lang_sort(channels_box[0] or [], name_fn=lambda c: c.get('name', ''), group_fn=lambda c: c.get('tv_genre_id', '') or c.get('genre_id', ''))
        xbmcplugin.setContent(self._handle, 'videos')
        from epg import build_epg_ui, build_now_inline, resolve_epg_key
        epg_cache   = epg_box[0] or {}
        portal_id   = p.get('id', 'unknown')
        epg_enabled = setting_bool('epg_enabled', True) and p.get('epg_show', True)
        upcoming    = setting_int('epg_lines', 3)
        now = time.time()
        for ch in channels:
            ch_name = ch.get('name', '')
            logo    = ch.get('logo', '')
            cmd     = ch.get('cmd', '')
            tvg_id  = ch.get('epg_channel_id') or str(ch.get('id', ''))
            epg_key = resolve_epg_key(portal_id, ch) if epg_enabled else None
            label2  = ''
            epg_plot = ''
            display_name = ch_name
            if epg_enabled and epg_key:
                label2, epg_plot = build_epg_ui(portal_id, epg_key, upcoming_count=upcoming)
                now_inline = build_now_inline(portal_id, epg_key)
                if now_inline:
                    display_name = f'{ch_name}  •  {now_inline}'
                if not label2:
                    label2 = 'keine Daten'
            li = xbmcgui.ListItem(label=display_name, label2=label2)
            li.setArt({'icon': logo, 'thumb': logo})
            info_d = {'title': ch_name, 'mediatype': 'video'}
            if epg_plot:
                info_d['plot'] = epg_plot
            li.setInfo('video', info_d)
            li.setProperty('IsPlayable', 'true')
            cm = [
                (('Remove from Favourites' if is_favourite(cmd) else 'Add to Favourites'),
                 f'RunPlugin({self.url(action="toggle_favourite", url=cmd, name=ch_name, logo=logo)})'),
                ('EPG',
                 f'Container.Update({self.url(action="epg_channel", pid=p["id"], tvg_id=tvg_id, name=ch_name)})'),
                (_L(32009),
                 f'Container.Update({self.url(action="stb_catchup_list", pid=p["id"], cmd=cmd, name=ch_name, tvg_id=tvg_id)})'),
            ]
            li.addContextMenuItems(cm)
            xbmcplugin.addDirectoryItem(
                self._handle,
                self.url(action='play_stb_live', pid=p['id'],
                         cmd=cmd, name=ch_name, logo=logo),
                li, False
            )
        xbmcplugin.addSortMethod(self._handle, xbmcplugin.SORT_METHOD_NONE)
        xbmcplugin.endOfDirectory(self._handle, succeeded=True, updateListing=False, cacheToDisc=False)

    def _stb_catchup_list(self):
        p = self._portal()
        if not p:
            return
        cmd    = self._params.get('cmd', '')
        name   = self._params.get('name', '')
        tvg_id = self._params.get('tvg_id', '')
        xbmcplugin.setContent(self._handle, 'videos')
        xbmcplugin.setPluginCategory(self._handle, f'{_L(32009)} – {name}')
        now     = time.time()
        days    = max(1, setting_int('epg_hours_back', 72) // 24)
        from_ts = now - days * 86400
        prgs    = []
        mgr = self._epg_mgr(p)
        if mgr:
            prgs = mgr.get_range(tvg_id, from_ts, now)
        if not prgs and tvg_id:
            stb = self._stb(p)
            if stb:
                for e in stb.get_short_epg(tvg_id, count=50):
                    try:
                        s = int(e.get('start_timestamp', e.get('time', 0)))
                        q = int(e.get('stop_timestamp',  e.get('time_to', 0)))
                        if s and q and q < now:
                            from epg import Programme
                            prgs.append(Programme(
                                channel=tvg_id, start=s, stop=q,
                                title=e.get('name', ''), desc=e.get('descr', '')
                            ))
                    except Exception:
                        pass
        if not prgs:
            notify(_L(32009), _L(32047))
            xbmcplugin.endOfDirectory(self._handle)
            return
        import datetime as _dt
        for pr in sorted(prgs, key=lambda x: x.start, reverse=True):
            dt_s = _dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(pr.start).strftime('%d/%m  %H:%M')
            li   = xbmcgui.ListItem(f'{dt_s}   {pr.title}')
            li.setInfo('video', {
                'title': pr.title, 'plot': pr.desc,
                'duration': max(0, pr.stop - pr.start), 'mediatype': 'video',
            })
            li.setProperty('IsPlayable', 'true')
            xbmcplugin.addDirectoryItem(
                self._handle,
                self.url(action='play_stb_catchup', pid=p['id'],
                         cmd=cmd, name=pr.title,
                         start=int(pr.start), stop=int(pr.stop)),
                li, False
            )
        xbmcplugin.endOfDirectory(self._handle)

    def _stb_account(self):
        p = self._portal()
        if not p:
            return
        stb    = self._stb(p)
        info_d = stb.get_account_info() if stb else {}
        lines = [
            f'Portal:  {p["name"]}',
            f'MAC:     {p.get("stb_mac", "")}',
        ]
        _status = info_d.get('status', '')
        if _status:
            lines.append(f'Status:  {_status}')
        _pv2 = info_d.get('phone', '')
        _end = info_d.get('end_date', '')
        if _pv2:
            import re as _re2
            _pv2_norm = _re2.sub(r'\b(am|pm)\b', lambda m: m.group().upper(), _pv2.strip(), flags=_re2.IGNORECASE)
            _matched2 = False
            for _fmt2 in ('%B %d, %Y, %I:%M %p', '%B %d, %Y, %-I:%M %p', '%B %d, %Y',
                          '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', '%Y-%m-%d', '%d.%m.%Y'):
                try:
                    import datetime as _dtp3
                    _exp2 = _dtp3.datetime.strptime(_pv2_norm, _fmt2)
                    _days2 = (_exp2 - _dtp3.datetime.now()).days
                    lines.append(f'Läuft ab: {_exp2.strftime("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M")}  ({_days2} Tage)')
                    _matched2 = True
                    break
                except Exception:
                    pass
            if not _matched2:
                lines.append(f'Läuft ab: {_pv2}')
        elif _end:
            try:
                import datetime as _dtp4
                _exp3 = _dtp4.datetime.strptime(_end[:10], '%Y-%m-%d')
                _days3 = (_exp3 - _dtp4.datetime.now()).days
                lines.append(f'Läuft ab: {_exp3.strftime("%d.%m.%Y")}  ({_days3} Tage)')
            except Exception:
                lines.append(f'Läuft ab: {_end}')
        _pkg = info_d.get('tariff_plan_name', '')
        if _pkg:
            lines.append(f'Paket:    {_pkg}')
        _mc = info_d.get('max_connections', '')
        if _mc:
            lines.append(f'Max conn: {_mc}')
        xbmcgui.Dialog().ok(_L(32013), '\n'.join(lines))
        xbmcplugin.endOfDirectory(self._handle)

    def _search_results(self):
        query = self._params.get('q', '')
        pid   = self._params.get('pid', '')
        if not query:
            xbmcplugin.endOfDirectory(self._handle)
            return
        xbmcplugin.setContent(self._handle, 'videos')
        xbmcplugin.setPluginCategory(self._handle, f'{_L(32005)}: {query}')
        import portals as P
        from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
        search_list = [P.get_by_id(pid)] if pid else P.get_active()
        search_list = [x for x in search_list if x]

        all_items = []
        workers   = min(len(search_list), 6)
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=workers) as pool:
            futures = {pool.submit(self._search_in_portal_collect, p, query): p
                       for p in search_list}
            for fut in as_completed(futures):
                try:
                    all_items.extend(fut.result())
                except Exception as e:
                    error(f'search thread error: {e}')

        all_items = apply_lang_sort(
            all_items,
            name_fn=lambda x: x[1].getLabel(),
            group_fn=lambda x: ''
        )
        for url, li, is_folder in all_items:
            xbmcplugin.addDirectoryItem(self._handle, url, li, is_folder)

        if not all_items:
            notify(_L(32005), _L(32046, query))
        xbmcplugin.endOfDirectory(self._handle)

    def _search_in_portal(self, p: dict, query: str) -> int:
        items = self._search_in_portal_collect(p, query)
        for url, li, is_folder in items:
            xbmcplugin.addDirectoryItem(self._handle, url, li, is_folder)
        return len(items)

    def _search_in_portal_collect(self, p: dict, query: str) -> list:
        ptype  = p.get('type', 'm3u')
        items  = []

        if ptype == 'stb':
            stb = self._stb(p)
            if stb:
                from iptv import Channel
                from player import channel_list_item
                for s in stb.search_live(query)[:50]:
                    ch = Channel(name=s.get('name', ''), url=s.get('cmd', ''),
                                 logo=s.get('logo', ''), group='Live')
                    items.append((
                        self.url(action='play_stb_live', pid=p['id'],
                                 cmd=s.get('cmd', ''), name=ch.name, logo=ch.logo),
                        channel_list_item(ch), False))
                for v in stb.search_vod(query)[:50]:
                    li = xbmcgui.ListItem(v.get('name', ''))
                    li.setInfo('video', {'title': v.get('name', ''), 'mediatype': 'movie'})
                    li.setProperty('IsPlayable', 'true')
                    items.append((
                        self.url(action='play_stb_vod', pid=p['id'],
                                 cmd=v.get('cmd', ''), name=v.get('name', '')),
                        li, False))

        elif ptype == 'xtream':
            xc = self._xc(p)
            if xc:
                from iptv import Channel
                from player import channel_list_item, vod_list_item
                for s in xc.search_live(query)[:50]:
                    ch = Channel(name=s.get('name', ''),
                                 url=xc.live_stream_url(s['stream_id']),
                                 logo=s.get('stream_icon', ''), group='Live')
                    items.append((
                        self.url(action='play_live', url=ch.url,
                                 name=ch.name, logo=ch.logo),
                        channel_list_item(ch), False))
                for v in xc.search_vod(query)[:50]:
                    li = vod_list_item(v)
                    items.append((
                        self.url(action='play_vod', pid=p['id'],
                                 stream_id=v.get('stream_id'),
                                 ext=v.get('container_extension', 'mkv'),
                                 title=v.get('name'), logo=v.get('stream_icon', '')),
                        li, False))
                for s in xc.search_series(query)[:50]:
                    li = xbmcgui.ListItem(s.get('name', ''))
                    li.setArt({'thumb': s.get('cover', ''), 'icon': s.get('cover', '')})
                    li.setInfo('video', {'title': s.get('name', ''),
                                         'mediatype': 'tvshow', 'plot': s.get('plot', '')})
                    items.append((
                        self.url(action='series_seasons', pid=p['id'],
                                 series_id=s.get('series_id')),
                        li, True))

        else:
            from iptv import load_m3u, split_m3u_sections
            all_ch   = load_m3u(p.get('m3u_url', ''), portal_id=p['id'])
            sections = split_m3u_sections(all_ch)
            q = query.lower()
            for section, mediatype in (
                ('live',   'video'),
                ('movies', 'movie'),
                ('series', 'episode'),
            ):
                for ch in sections.get(section, []):
                    if q in ch.name.lower() or q in (ch.group or '').lower():
                        li = xbmcgui.ListItem(ch.name)
                        li.setArt({'thumb': ch.logo, 'icon': ch.logo})
                        li.setInfo('video', {'title': ch.name, 'mediatype': mediatype})
                        li.setProperty('IsPlayable', 'true')
                        items.append((
                            self.url(action='play_live', url=ch.url,
                                     name=ch.name, logo=ch.logo),
                            li, False))
                        if len(items) >= 200:
                            return apply_lang_sort(items, name_fn=lambda x: x[1].getLabel(), group_fn=lambda x: '')
        return apply_lang_sort(items, name_fn=lambda x: x[1].getLabel(), group_fn=lambda x: '')


    def _epg_now(self):
        # The old manager iterated raw XMLTV IDs, bypassing sender mappings and
        # short-EPG. Use the same actual-channel preview as the TV overlay.
        self._epg_status(preview_first=True)

    def _epg_status(self, preview_first=False):
        if self._handle >= 0:
            xbmcplugin.endOfDirectory(self._handle,succeeded=False,cacheToDisc=False)
        p = self._portal()
        if p:
            from epg_preview import show
            show(p,preview_first=preview_first)

    def _epg_channel(self):
        p = self._portal()
        if not p:
            return
        tvg_id = self._params.get('tvg_id', '')
        name   = self._params.get('name', tvg_id)
        sid = self._params.get('sid','')
        if sid:
            # A freshly edited mapping must not depend on a stale stream alias
            # left by an earlier XMLTV import. Share TV/preview resolution.
            xbmcplugin.endOfDirectory(self._handle,succeeded=False,cacheToDisc=False)
            from epg import load_cache
            from epg_sources import configuration
            from epg_views import resolve_guide
            from epg_preview import programme_lines
            info=resolve_guide(load_cache(p['id']),tvg_id,sid,
                client=self._xc(p) if p.get('type')=='xtream' else None,
                mappings=configuration(p['id'])['mappings'])
            xbmcgui.Dialog().textviewer('XCMate - '+name,'\n'.join(programme_lines(info)))
            return
        xbmcplugin.setContent(self._handle, 'videos')
        xbmcplugin.setPluginCategory(self._handle, f'EPG – {name}')
        mgr = self._epg_mgr(p)
        now  = time.time()
        back = setting_int('epg_hours_back', 3) * 3600
        ahead= setting_int('epg_hours_ahead', 12) * 3600
        prgs = mgr.get_range(tvg_id, now - back, now + ahead) if mgr else []
        import datetime as _dt
        for pr in prgs:
            dt_s  = _dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(pr.start).strftime('%H:%M')
            label = f'{dt_s}  {pr.title}'

                'title': pr.title, 'plot': pr.desc,
                'genre': pr.category, 'episode': pr.episode,

            })
            if pr.stop < now:
                xbmcplugin.addDirectoryItem(
                    self._handle,
                    self.url(action='play_catchup', pid=p['id'],
                             start=int(pr.start), stop=int(pr.stop),
                             tvg_id=tvg_id, name=pr.title),

        logo = self._params.get('logo', '')
        if url and '%25' in url:
            url = urllib.parse.unquote(url)
        if not url and self._params.get('sid'):
            # Widgets only store non-secret portal IDs and Xtream stream IDs.
            import portals as _portal_store
            p = _portal_store.get_by_id(self._params.get('pid',''))
            if p and p.get('type') == 'xtream':

            notify('XCMate', 'Stream URL fehlt')
            xbmcplugin.setResolvedUrl(self._handle, False, xbmcgui.ListItem())
            return
        # The service displays a transparent on-video TV remote panel. Never
        # put the stream URL or Xtream credentials in the session marker.
        session=None

        from xtream import XtreamClient
        active=_portals.get_active()
        requested_pid=self._params.get('pid')

        from play_intent import before_play

        return p

    def _xc(self, p: dict):
        if not p: return None
        if p.get('type') in ('m3u','stb'):
            from source_adapters import for_portal
            return for_portal(p)
        if p.get('type')!='xtream': return None
        from xtream import XtreamClient
        return XtreamClient(p['xc_host'], p['xc_user'], p['xc_pass'])

    def _stb(self, p: dict):
        if not p or p.get('type') != 'stb':
            return None
        from stalker import client_for_portal
        return client_for_portal(p)

    def _epg_cache(self, p: dict):
        try:
            from epg import load_cache
            portal_id = p.get('id', 'unknown')
            return load_cache(portal_id)
        except Exception:
            return {}

    def _epg_mgr(self, p: dict):
        from epg import EPGManager
        data = self._epg_cache(p)
        if not data:
            return None
        return EPGManager(data)

    def _load_channels(self, p: dict, force: bool = False):
        ptype = p.get('type', 'm3u')
        if ptype == 'stb':
            from stalker import client_for_portal
            from iptv import Channel
            stb = client_for_portal(p)
            if not stb or not stb.authenticate():
                return []
            cats = {str(c['id']): c.get('title', '')
                    for c in stb.get_live_categories(force=force)}
            return [
                Channel(
                    name    = s.get('name', ''),
                    url     = s.get('cmd', ''),
                    logo    = s.get('logo', ''),
                    group   = cats.get(str(s.get('genre_id',
                                               s.get('tv_genre_id', ''))),
                                       'Uncategorised'),
                    tvg_id  = s.get('epg_channel_id') or str(s.get('id', '')),
                    tvg_name= s.get('name', ''),
                )
                for s in stb.get_live_channels(force=force)
            ]
        elif ptype == 'xtream':
            from xtream import XtreamClient
            from iptv import Channel
            xc   = XtreamClient(p['xc_host'], p['xc_user'], p['xc_pass'])
            # Never block back navigation with server requests. Kodi service
            # preloads these two indexes independently of the interface.
            cats_raw = (xc.get_live_categories(force_refresh=True) if force else
                        xc.get_cached_catalog('get_live_categories'))
            channels_raw = (xc.get_live_streams(force_refresh=True) if force else
                            xc.get_cached_catalog('get_live_streams'))
            if cats_raw is None or channels_raw is None:
                return []
            cats = {str(c['category_id']): c.get('category_name', '')
                    for c in cats_raw if isinstance(c, dict) and 'category_id' in c}
            return [
                Channel(
                    name    = s.get('name', ''),
                    url     = xc.live_stream_url(s.get('stream_id', ''), 'ts'),
                    logo    = s.get('stream_icon', ''),
                    group   = cats.get(str(s.get('category_id', '')), 'Uncategorised'),
                    extra   = {'category_id': str(s.get('category_id', '')),
                               'stream_id': str(s.get('stream_id', ''))},
                    tvg_id  = s.get('epg_channel_id', ''),
                    tvg_name= s.get('name', ''),
                )
                for s in channels_raw if isinstance(s, dict)
            ]
        else:
            from iptv import load_m3u
            url = p.get('m3u_url', '').strip()
            if not url:
                error(f'load_channels: portal "{p.get("name")}" has no m3u_url')
                return []
            return load_m3u(url,
                            portal_id=p.get('id', ''),
                            force_refresh=force)

    def _add_dir(self, label, url, icon=None, is_folder=True, plot='', fanart=None):

        li.setInfo('video', {'title': label, 'plot': plot or label})
        if not is_folder:
            li.setProperty('IsPlayable', 'true')
        xbmcplugin.addDirectoryItem(self._handle, url, li, isFolder=is_folder)

class Router:
    def __init__(self, argv):
        self._handle = int(argv[1])
        self._base   = argv[0]
        args = argv[2][1:] if len(argv) > 2 else ''
        self._params = dict(urllib.parse.parse_qsl(args, keep_blank_values=True))

    def url(self, **kw):
        return self._base + '?' + urllib.parse.urlencode(
            {k: v for k, v in kw.items() if v is not None},
            quote_via=urllib.parse.quote
        )

    def dispatch(self):
        from experimental45 import protected,active,route

            self._end_directory(succeeded=False,cacheToDisc=False);return
        # Log a route before imports/settings work; arbitrary query text is not logged.
        mark('ROUTE', action=action)
        from window_lifecycle import route_phase
        route_phase(self,'ENTRY',action)
        with phase('PORTALS_IMPORT'):
            import portals as _portals_mod
        # No migration/settings writes on every root or parallel widget request.
        # Legacy settings can be imported explicitly from the empty-profile menu.

        R = {

            'm3u_movies'         : self._m3u_movies,

            'm3u_movie_list'     : self._m3u_movie_list,

            'widget_groups'      : self._widget_groups,
            'widget_channels'    : self._widget_channels,
            'media_details'      : self._media_details,
            'trailer'            : self._trailer,
            'vod_categories'     : self._vod_categories,
            'vod_list'           : self._vod_list,
            'series_categories'  : self._series_categories,
            'series_list'        : self._series_list,
